Kancor Ingredients Limited.event: Renamed to Mane Kancor Ingredients Private Limited
Kancor Ingredients Limited.evidence: According to the company's milestone registry and corporate Ministry of Corporate Affairs data, Kancor Ingredients Limited officially changed its name to Mane Kancor Ingredients Private Limited in 2021. The official website (manekancor.com) confirms that the operational entity manufactures and supplies spice oleoresins, whole spices, and customized seasonings.
